neighbours.label: a noun naming what a business offers or handles (products, entertainment, ordering, stock) in commercial text
fire: Our shop ships its handmade products to customers across the country.
The station promises to keep bringing you the best local entertainment every weekend.
Staff are responsible for ordering supplies and tracking inventory each month.
The new catalogue lists every product we carry, with prices and photos.
Nos clients peuvent commander tous nos produits directement en ligne.
The warehouse keeps enough stock on hand to fill orders within two days.
Customers love how quickly our merchandise arrives after checkout.
The retailer expanded its range of goods to include garden tools.
quiet: Our shop thanks its loyal customers across the country every holiday.
The station promises to keep bringing you the friendliest local hosts every weekend.
Staff are responsible for greeting visitors and answering phones each month.
The new catalogue opens with a letter from our founder and her family.
Nos clients peuvent nous appeler directement le matin.
The warehouse keeps enough workers on hand to cover every shift.
Customers love how friendly our cashiers are after checkout.
The retailer expanded its opening hours to include Sunday mornings.
